questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

*1) *ADGPI → 1st and 5th letters are vowels.

*2) *ECVMU → 1st and 5th letters are vowels.

*3) *OMKLU → 1st and 5th letters are vowels.

*4) *VDCKA → 1st letter is a consonant and 5th letters is a vowel.

Hence, ‘VDCKA’ is the odd one out.

questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
questions.solution:
Each letter-clusters contain only consonant in it but, only **'ET'** contains a vowel **'E'** in it.

Hence, **'ET' ** is different from the rest three.

questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

1. BASK → 3 Consonants, 1 Vowel

2. SPIT → 3 Consonants, 1 Vowel

3. TRAM → 3 Consonants, 1 Vowel

4. MOVE → 2 Consonants, 2 Vowels

Hence, ‘**MOVE**’ is the odd one out.

questions.question: Four letter clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:
The positions of letters according to the English alphabet series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6500bccef3874e27b8cdd222f7b2819e86fc260f658a57f5ef13e64219a9b1d4.png] 

Here, the logic is :

The Middle alphabet is a vowel in all options except option 4.

B**I**Z → Here "I" is the vowel

M**O**W → Here "O" is the vowel

C**U**Z → Here "U" is the vowel

Except, 

**A**BY → Here "A" is the vowel but Not in the middle place.

Hence, 'ABY' is odd among all.

questions.question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd one.
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/255a22c958f21c44ea260ae89ee168d39745a649cb733dc79cbd17e567acb576.png] 

The pattern followed is,

**Sum of positional value of 1st and 2nd alphabet = Positional value of 3rd alphabet.**

J(10) + P(16) = Z(26)

**M(13) + Q(17) = S(19)**

D(4) + L(12) = P(16)

F(6) + H(8) = N(14)

All follow the same pattern, except ‘MQS’.

Hence, “MQS” is the odd letter cluster.
